summary: AmperCap Acquisition Company filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its IPO on June 4, 2026, selling 12,500,000 units at $10.00 per unit for gross proceeds of $125,000,000. Each unit consists of one ordinary share and one right entitling the holder to receive one-tenth of an ordinary share upon a future business combination. Simultaneously, it completed a private placement of 512,500 units to sponsor AmperSPAC LLC, underwriter EarlyBirdCapital, and third-party investors for $5,125,000. On June 10, 2026, underwriters partially exercised their over-allotment option, purchasing 1,837,500 additional units at $10.00 for $18,375,000. Total proceeds of approximately $144,808,750 were placed in a trust account. This is a standard SPAC IPO and private placement. What to watch: the trust-account value per unit and timing of any de-SPAC transaction.
